QuestInfo.name: New Enemies and New Friends
QuestInfo.0: The child empress, #p1101000#, has much on her shoulders, but she's not the only one.
QuestInfo.1: First #p1033100# feared that the Black Mage was coming back, and #p1012100# confirmed that there were signs of his return. You made a new friend in the Cygnus Knights, but now you have to fight the Black Wings as well. At the end of the day, your mission is the same: Grow strong enough to release your people from their curse. You just have defeat the Black Mage while you're at it. Easy, right? Let #b#p1012100##k know that you've joined forces with #p1101000#. That will put her mind at ease.
QuestInfo.2: You learned that you will have to fight the Black Mage again, but your first responsibility is to your people. As the monarch of the Elves, you must grow strong enough until you can lift their curse.

0.0: I feel like I haven't had a chance to gather my thoughts in far too long. Hearing from #p1033100# changed everything. The Black Mage is coming, and his curse still has its hold over the Elves...
0.1: At least I was able to find #p1012100#. But then the Black Wings found us, and now the Black Mage's minions know where to find us.
0.2: Thankfully, now we have Empress #p1101000# on our side, and her knights seem strong enough to keep the village safe.
0.3: I can't shake this feeling of dread. The Black Mage's shadow lingers over Maple World once more... And the person at the front of that battle is a frail little girl. Will she be ready to fight when the time comes?
0.4: All I can do is make sure the Elves are ready. #b#p1012100##k will want to know about our alliance with  #p1101000#.\r\n#b#e(You will be moved to Athena Pierce if you accept.)#n#k

1.0: Your Highness! #p1101002# wrote that he's sent knights to the village. Elluel should be safe for now. I'm glad we...is something wrong? You don't look well.\r\n#L0##bThis Empress... Is she all right? Can she really stand against the Black Mage?#l\n#k
1.1: I didn't believe it at first. Empress #p1101000# has had more responsibility forced upon her than she was ready for. But...\r\n#L0##bBut?#l\n#k
1.2: You taught me that a good ruler goes to any lengths to save her people. And that's exactly the kind of ruler she is.

yes.0: Empress #p1101000# reminds me of you, Your Highness. She's got her back to a cliff, but she won't back down. Ever.

default.0: It'll be nice to see #b#p1012100##k again.
